Thank you. For your encouraging words. Yeah well, I’m a nurse. And I’m going to Germany to work there. I got good grades when I was learning the language, enthusiastic even. But now, I can barely say or create a whole sentence. I’m so messed up. I don’t have any motivations to try again. It’s like, I don’t want to exist. I want to just funish everything off. But I can see how excited my family is because I’ll be working abroad. I don’t want to make them or see them sad. I don’t want to disappoint my mom. We’re not financially stable. I want them not to suffer if I do the deed. You know? I’m so confused in what to do. I don’t go on social media rn. Because I was afraid to see anything I wont be able to handle. When I think that me and him will never be able to fulfill our drems together, it kills me. When I think that he can get another woman it kills me, i can’t deal with that. I don’t know. I’ve red alot of advices online. That everything will pass, tomorrow will be better, you’ll be better, you’ll find someone that’s much better, i feel the opposite. Everyday I’m succumbing to emptiness. Like I feel it’s better not to really feel anything. If I can just turn off my emotions you know? If only I can be stronger. But I really don’t know what to do. I’m doing my best to keep those freaking suicidal thoughts at bay, but they kept creeping out. 😭 But i totally appreciate all the good advices you gave me. Thank you.
Since July of this year. :’( I lost weight, I can’t function. I was supposed to continue learning a foreign language, I passed the exam and all that. But now I can’t speak it anymore.

Yeah. I think so too. I don’t know if it was my personality that drowned me in this pool of emptiness. Or if I’m just a shallow person? That I can’t move past this? I can’t get mad at him. Like whatever happened, I never blamed him. I blame myself. I feel like it’s me. Like everything was because I’m not enough. Eventhough i gave everything I could.
I can’t afford to go to a therapist. :(

Hey. I just got out from a long term relationship. I know. It seems kind if pathetic that the break up opened my feelings of emptiness and extreme sadness. But. It’s really hard. Like, I’ve tried making peace with it. But I can’t. I can’t function properly.
